verses.english: Linked Discourses 4.18
2. Rule
Alms Food

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā magadhesu viharati pañcasālāyaṁ brāhmaṇagāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying in the land of the Magadhans near the brahmin village of Pañcasālā.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena pañcasālāyaṁ brāhmaṇagāme kumārikānaṁ pāhunakāni bhavanti.
verses.english: Now at that time in Pañcasālā the young maidens were occupied with guests.

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṁ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya pañcasālaṁ brāhmaṇagāmaṁ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
verses.english: Then the Buddha robed up in the morning and, taking his bowl and robe, entered Pañcasālā for alms.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena pañcasāleyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā mārena pāpimatā anvāviṭṭhā bhavanti:
verses.english: Now at that time Māra had possessed the brahmins and householders of Pañcasālā, so that they thought,
“Don’t let the ascetic Gotama get any alms!”

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā yathādhotena pattena pañcasālaṁ brāhmaṇagāmaṁ piṇḍāya pāvisi tathādhotena pattena paṭikkami.
verses.english: Then the Buddha left the village with his bowl as clean-washed as it was when he entered for alms.

verses.pali: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Māra the Wicked went up to the Buddha and said to him,
“Well, ascetic, did you get any alms?”

verses.pali: “Tathā nu tvaṁ, pāpima, akāsi yathāhaṁ piṇḍaṁ na labheyyan”ti.
verses.english: “Wicked One, did you make sure I didn’t get any alms?”

verses.pali: “Tena hi, bhante, bhagavā dutiyampi pañcasālaṁ brāhmaṇagāmaṁ piṇḍāya pavisatu.
verses.english: “Well then, sir, let the Buddha enter Pañcasālā a second time for alms.

verses.pali: Tathāhaṁ karissāmi yathā bhagavā piṇḍaṁ lacchatī”ti.
verses.english: I’ll make sure you get alms.”
“Māra has produced wickedness
in attacking the Realized One.
Wicked One, do you imagine that
your wickedness won’t bear fruit?
Let us live so very happily,
we who have nothing.
We shall feed on rapture,
like the gods of streaming radiance.”

verses.pali: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṁ bhagavā, jānāti maṁ sugato”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.
verses.english: Then Māra the Wicked, thinking, “The Buddha knows me! The Holy One knows me!” miserable and sad, vanished right there.
